question:
The following table shows CFC emission (in million metric tons) form various sectors for an industry for a period of 5 years. Based on the table answer the question given below.

 
 

 Sector

 450

Which sector has recorded the maximum percentage growth in CFC emission from 2015 to 2019?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The percentage growth of Cement from 2015 to 2019 = [(450 – 200)/200 × 100]

⇒ (250/200 × 100)

⇒ 125%

The percentage growth of Fertilizer from 2015 to 2019 = [(800 – 500)/500 × 100]

⇒ (300/500 × 100)

⇒ 60%

The percentage growth of Foam from 2015 to 2019 = [(200 – 80/80 × 100]

⇒ (120/80 × 100)

⇒ 150%

The percentage growth of Pesticides from 2015 to 2019 = [(180 – 100)/100 × 100]

⇒ (80/100 × 100)

⇒ 80%

**∴ The maximum growth in CFC from 2015 to 2019 in Foam**
